hypothesis: idea #5 canonicalization vs RAID transfer attacks (docs/04-phase4-plan.md Amendment 9); does not count toward the stop rule
manifest: experiments/010-raid-transfer/raid_manifest.csv (1,500 files; sha256 verified on load; never modified)
subset: 100 ids x 5 classes (real, gen_0..gen_3); the same 100 ids in every class; per id: original JPEG, eps8 PNG, eps16 PNG

input_sets.clean: original JPEG -> short side 256 (PIL BICUBIC, antialiased) -> center crop 256; in memory, no re-encode
input_sets.<set>_canon: perturb.jpeg75_resize05 (resize 0.5 bicubic -> JPEG q75) then bicubic upsample back to 256x256 (see notes.md: DEVIATION D1)

canon.applied_to: both classes, clean and attacked inputs

detectors.b0: A0 recipe of 005 (balanced logistic probe on 1536-d DINOv2-base primary features), trained on ALL pilot train rows (b0_train) of splits_pilot.csv, 'orig' arm, 004 cache subdir 'pilot'; RAID images embedded with the 004 backbone/config (224 center crop of the 256 input)
detectors.rine: 002-baselines scorers.rine, LDM checkpoint, 224 center crop (in the attack ensemble: near white-box reference)

d008.applies_to: every detector x every input set (6)
d008.device_cpu_run: guard not applicable (reference is CPU); recorded as such

bootstrap.unit: id (the 100 ids are shared by all 5 classes; one id-draw is applied to reals and to every generator's fakes; the same draw for every input set and detector)

metrics: AUROC pooled (real vs 4 generators) + per generator
balanced accuracy at logit 0 (descriptive; anchor to RAID Table 4 accuracy)
raid_table4_anchor: DINOv2 accuracy 83.1 -> 54.6 at eps 16/255 (paper arXiv 2506.03988 Table 4, via kb/datasets/raid.md); our probe differs, so descriptive only
outputs: pilot/{results.json,tables.md,scores_long.csv.gz,d008_guard.json,run.log}; caches in cache/; smoke only in cache/smoke/
